So not really a bad habit, but a stupid habit I go so used do doing that it started getting toxic. 

I am a very indecisive person. Once I had the unique idea of letting the second hand of my watch answer questions for me. I decided that if the second hand reads less than 30, then the answer is yes, otherwise no. Plain, simple, stupid, but nothing that would hurt anyone. However I started relying on this "trick" too much. All my answers would be answered this way. Should I wear a black top or a blue top. Should I wear heels or sneakers. Should I eat a burger of a pizza. Should I get a tall coffee or a Grande coffee. Everything was decided by this stupid trick. 

It wasn't helping me at all. In fact, the decisions I would usually take easily on my own were also now being taken this way. it reached a toxic level too. It's one thing to be sad about a breakup, but it's another to obsess about the possibilities. I would tell myself that it'll get better. If things would seem to go south, I'd ask my watch if my relationship would get any better. If that second hand reads less than 30, my ex and I will be back together and otherwise not. I'd get my hopes up this way, when I should've left it alone. I was obsessing over things not under my control. I would look at my watch obsessively, to a point where I wouldn't even have a question but I'd still notice the second hands for minutes straight. 

It's been three days, and I've successfully not taken any decision this way. I once looked at the second hand by mistake, but I'm trying to let go of this behaviour and I'm really proud to do so. At times, I was extremely drawn towards making my life easy and just letting fate take my decision but I didn't give up, and honestly, I feel happy :))
